2026-07-22.title: Compound chain intro — stations 5-8 (race weight, half volume)

blocks.text: Diagnostic session — first time chaining full race weight. Half volume throughout. This is the London cramp zone (runs 6-7-8) and the Birmingham collapse zone (lunges, wall balls). Spinal RPE (effort + symptom, separate) logged immediately after Farmers Carry, Lunge, and Wall Balls — not end of session. If symptom RPE climbs progressively across the three checkpoints, that's the chained-fatigue signal. Don't push to full volume even if it feels fine — next week's decision depends on what these three checkpoints say.
